title: devbin hosting's read-only sweep drives agents sync, a writer, and the retired fileindex
body:
`bin/devbin hosting` says its default sweep is READ-ONLY and drives only `READONLY_VERBS`, but that list includes `agents sync` (`bin/.devbin/cmd/hosting`), which rewrites AGENTS.md: the file's own incident record says so, and `docs/reference/commands.md` classes `intent agents sync` as a writer. The run happens in a clone, so the damage is contained, but the label and the closing "READ-ONLY VERBS ONLY" line are false.

The same list also carries `fileindex bin`, and `intent fileindex` was retired in v3 (it refuses at exit 2), so the default sweep drives a verb that can only refuse.

Fix: move `agents sync` to `MUTATING_VERBS` and drop `fileindex bin`. XS. Found in dc's doc sweep of 2026-09-18 (finding C-24).


CLOSED 2026-09-19, by its landing in dc's train C on vc's word (bank 91948f18a, patch-id aecfc2f6b994, judged green on the train's bats log refs/bank/dc/trainC/bats.log: every arm green on the fixed script and the new arm red on the unfixed one).
